profile.headline:
Staff Software Engineer - Controls
GE Aerospace

positions.title: Gas Turbines Systems Engineer
positions.description:
- Managed root cause analyses for field issues while working directly with global customers on a recurring basis.
- Supported engine combustion mapping/tuning (LM2500 +/+G4 and LM6000 PF/PF+) both remotely and on-site on occasion
- Led a team to develop combustion emissions and acoustics optimization software for gas turbine engines.
- Worked with LNG customers to extend life of engines by providing recommendations based off of a condition-based maintenance framework (CBM)

positions.title: Technology Development Intern
positions.description:
This internship was an R&D position with a couple of projects that I supported prior to beginning my role at BHGE:

1) Design of experiment (DOE) to identify to identify an optimal material selection
2) Simulink library support and development
3) Familiarization with cam design/theory to support maturation activities (prior to starting at BHGE)

positions.title: Systems Engineering Intern
positions.description: Supported staff with running fuel systems simulations to correlate lab data against customer's requirements.  This role was one of the most eye-opening learning experiences I've had as an introduction to gas turbine design even if it was just surrounding the fuel system design.  This was the learning experience that I felt really gave me the humbling and appreciation for gas turbine system design.

company.name: The University of Texas Rio Grande Valley

positions.title: Data Analyst
positions.description: Supported graduate level seminars focused on Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) by reviewing papers and presenting on recent advances in sensor technology.

educations.fieldOfStudy: Mechanical Engineering with a minor in Chemistry
